'''

import tkinter as tk

from url_shortener import URLShortener

class MainApp:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("URL Shortener")

        self.url_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Enter URL:")
        self.url_label.pack()

        self.shorten_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Shorten URL", command=self.shorten_url)
        self.shorten_button.pack()
        
        self.result_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="")
        self.result_label.pack()
        
        self.url_shortener = URLShortener()
        
        self.root.mainloop()
    
    def shorten_url(self):
        long_url = self.url_entry.get()
        if long_url:
            try:
                short_url = self.url_shortener.shorten(long_url)
                self.result_label.config(text=f"Shortened URL: {short_url}")

   ```bash
   export TINYURL_API_KEY='your_tinyurl_api_key'

   ```
